OSHA's Form 300A

Summary of Work-Related Injuries and Illnesses
 Year {{ doc.year }}
All establishments covered by Part 1904 must complete this Summary page, even if no work-related injuries or illnesses occurred during the year. Employees, former employees, and their representatives have the right to review the OSHA Form 300 in its entirety. They also have limited access to the OSHA Form 301 or its equivalent.
